notablePrerequisites: {1} fewer mana required on the first turn if Mystic Reflection was foretold.
description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Archaeomancer.
Cast From Under the Floorboards by paying {3}{B}{B}, creating three token copies of Archaeomancer and gaining 3 life.
Each of the Archaeomancer's ETBs trigger, returning Mystic Reflection, Time Warp, and From Under the Floorboards to your hand.
Repeat.
